url.label: URL
url.hint: http or https. Each inserted value is encoded, so it cannot change the host or add a path. Internal addresses and ports other than 80/443 need the organization's allowlist.

headers.title: Headers
headers.name: Header name
headers.invalid: A header name uses letters, digits and - _ . ! # $ % & ' * + ^ ` | ~ only.
headers.forbidden: Cellhive sets {{name}} itself: remove this header.
headers.duplicate: {{name}} is already set (or is the authentication header): keep one.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.headerHint: The secret's value is sent as this header, e.g. Authorization: Bearer … or X-Api-Key.
auth.secretHint: Header secrets of the organization usable in this base. Their value is never shown here.

body.title: Body
body.get: A GET request has no body: choose another method or remove the body.
body.jsonHint: Inserted values are escaped as JSON text: put text values in quotes, e.g. "name": "{{ … }}".
body.jsonInvalidAt: This is not valid JSON (near character {{position, number}}).
body.digestKept: This body is a list of records set outside the builder: it is kept as is.

signing.label: Sign the request
signing.hint: With a signing secret the request carries Standard Webhooks headers (webhook-signature) the receiver can verify.

failOnError.label: Fail the step on an HTTP error
failOnError.hint: Off: a 4xx or 5xx answer still ends the step successfully and later steps can read its status. Temporary errors are retried either way.

none.http_header: No header secret is shared with this base
none.webhook_signing: No signing secret is shared with this base

secret.askAdmin: Ask an owner or admin of the organization to add one in the organization's integrations.
secret.addThere: Add one in the organization's integrations.

paths.title: Values for later steps
paths.hint: Later steps can use these parts of the response through "+". Pick more from a test response, or type a path.
paths.invalid: Write a path under body, e.g. body.id or body.items[0].sku.

test.title: Send a test
test.hint: Sends this step as you see it now, with your permissions, through the same checks as a real run. Earlier steps do not run: their values are empty.
test.webhookSample: Values from the webhook request come from the sample request captured at {{time}}.
test.webhookNoSample: This hook has no sample request yet: values from the webhook request will be empty. Listen for a sample request in the trigger first.
test.noSampleSent: Sent without a sample request: values from the webhook request were empty.
test.notSaved: Save the automation once to send a test.
test.incomplete: Complete the step first (see the problems above).
test.noRecords: The trigger table has no record to test with.

result.retrying: Attempt {{attempts, number}} of {{max, number}} failed: trying again shortly…
result.allowlistHint: {{host}} is an internal address: an owner or admin of the organization can add it to the allowlist.
result.pathsHint: Offer a value of this response in the "+" menu of later steps.

ssrf.invalid_url: This URL cannot be called (scheme, user name, length or characters).
ssrf.port_not_allowed: This port is not open: only 80 and 443 are, unless the host and port are in the allowlist.
ssrf.private_address: This host is on an internal network.
ssrf.blocked_address: This address can never be called (cloud metadata, broadcast or reserved): use another URL.
ssrf.unresolvable: This host name could not be found: check it.
ssrf.unknown: The call was blocked by the outbound network rules.

error.rate_limited: The destination asked to wait {{seconds, number}} seconds or more.
error.http_timeout: The destination did not answer in time.
error.http_network: The destination could not be reached.
error.http_response_too_large: The response is larger than 1 MB.
error.http_request_too_large: The request body is larger than 1 MB.
error.secret_unavailable: A secret of this step is no longer usable in this base.
error.invalid_value: A value of this step could not be used (the URL is not text, or the JSON body does not parse).
error.secret_host_not_allowed: The URL of this HTTP step is not an allowed host of its secret (a plain http URL needs an entry with its port): nothing was sent. Add the host to the secret in the organization settings if it is the real receiver.
error.secret_host_not_allowed_legacy_expired: The secret of this HTTP step was created before allowed hosts existed and its transition period is over: set its allowed hosts in the organization settings.

n8n.intro: Sends the trigger record to an n8n workflow: a signed POST with a standard JSON payload, built with the permissions of the person the automation runs as.
n8n.urlHint: The production URL of the Webhook node (…/webhook/…), method POST.
n8n.secretHint: Required. In n8n, verify the webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers (Standard Webhooks) with the same secret.
n8n.fieldsAllHint: Every field the automation can read when it runs, new fields included.
n8n.noRecord: This trigger has no record: the payload has the event, the automation and the base, and record is null.
n8n.changesHint: Old and new value of the fields sent that changed.

preview.title: Example payload
preview.hint: Values are placeholders. The real payload holds only what {{name}} can read when the step runs.

secretHosts.sentTo: This secret is sent only to: {{hosts}}.
secretHosts.unchecked: A URL from values is checked when the step runs.
secretHosts.notListedTitle: {{host}} is not an allowed host of this secret
secretHosts.ipTitle: An IP address never matches the allowed hosts of a secret
secretHosts.plainHttpTitle: This secret is not sent over plain http
secretHosts.plainHttp: {{host}} is allowed over https only: plain http would send the secret unencrypted, so saving will be refused. Use https://, or add {{host}}:{{port}} to the secret in the organization settings if this receiver really has no https.
secretHosts.notListed: Saving will be refused, and nothing would be sent there. Allowed hosts: {{hosts}}. Use one of them, or add {{host}} to the secret in the organization settings.
secretHosts.legacyTitle: This secret has no allowed hosts yet
secretHosts.legacy: It was created before allowed hosts existed and is still sent to any host until {{date}}; after that, this step fails. Set its hosts in the organization settings.
secretHosts.expired: It was created before allowed hosts existed and its transition period is over: saving is refused and runs of this step fail until its allowed hosts are set.
